decisions.reason: As a recent add-on to the established floor-care offer, the cleaning soap is easy to justify as part of the full flooring system and management is likely to persist unless results are clearly poor.

The maintenance oil is tightly linked to the firm's installed base of wood floors and, as a multi-model line, carries enough investment and visible commitment to make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
This care line for oiled floors fits directly with the firm's core aftercare strategy, so disappointing early results can readily be framed as temporary while management stays committed.
The moisture-protection underlay supports the firm's system-selling logic, but as a more peripheral accessory than the floors themselves it is somewhat easier to remove if uptake disappoints.

The high-density underlay foam complements the flooring business, yet it is a relatively substitutable accessory and therefore slightly more droppable despite the tendency to continue recent launches.

The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core business, likely required substantial launch effort across several models, and is therefore the product management is most likely to defend and retain.
